description: Draws a stock screen's results in the chat as an interactive, sortable table. Call it when the user asks to see a screen or a list of stocks matching criteria, or when that table is itself the answer. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. ScreenStocks returns the rows.

filters.description: The screen, as one object holding exactly the arguments ScreenStocks takes, e.g. {"index":"sp-500","maxPe":15}.

name: ShowScreenerResults
title: Show Screener Results
